responsibility: Implements the default-input read-result query by delegating to IOChan.ReadResult on StdChans.StdInChan. Its role is to expose ISO SIOResult semantics without owning device or parsing logic, simply bridging default-channel access to the underlying per-channel read-status store.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file provides the implementation of SIOResult by delegating ReadResult to IOChan.ReadResult(StdChans.StdInChan()). It differs from SIOResult.def, which merely defines the exported ReadResults type alias and procedure signature.
